judged_text: The loading view reloads unconditionally every 30 seconds with no failure or terminal state, so any retrieval that never produces a topic leaves the embed in an endless reload loop. When retrieval can never succeed (embed_by_username unset or misspelled, article host != embeddable_host, fetch/readability error), every viewer's iframe reloads forever, and each reload re-requests embed/best which enqueues another RetrieveTopic Sidekiq job (embed_controller.rb line 10) — unbounded job growth per viewer for permanently failing URLs.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it always enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The loading template unconditionally `document.location.reload()` every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb) with no terminal/failure state. If retrieval never results in a `TopicEmbed` record (e.g., `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` returns early when `embed_by_username` user is missing/blank, or remote fetch/readability fails), the iframe will reload forever and each reload will enqueue another `retrieve_topic` job. While `TopicRetriever` throttles *work* via Redis (`retrieved_recently?`), it does not prevent repeated job enqueues, so job volume can grow with viewers for permanently failing URLs.
